title: Lower bound on table code length
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every table assigning an action on two work tapes to each state and each triple of optional input and work symbols over the binary alphabet, the length of its Boolean code is at least $351(n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: the table has the specified domain and action values
